## Underwriting Analytics & Submission Auditor

An interactive companion to my Crestline quota-share analysis. The application combines portfolio KPIs, loss-ratio reconstruction, geographic concentration, scenario testing, deterministic CSV auditing, methodology, and the complete written report.

<a class="finance-link" href="underwriting-analytics.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the full-screen application <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right"></i></a>

<div class="data-panel">
<h3>Download the de-identified source data</h3>
<p>Use the policy bordereaux and loss run in the application’s Submission Auditor. Direct names and transaction-level dates have been removed, and policy and claim IDs have been consistently pseudonymized; the analytical fields and totals are unchanged.</p>
